messages:
maria: Quick preflight: vendor starting next Tue. Need explicit retest acceptance criteria, RBAC pattern for assessors, KMS gating, and evidence retention window. Who can own certifying the retest?

sam: I can own vendor SLA language. We require 72h P1. Add a clause: vendor must provide exploit repro steps and patch plan within 24h of disclosure. Also need notification path (Slack + email).

eva: For RBAC, no long-lived roles. We'll issue ephemeral STS credentials with a policy limited to a single S3 prefix + CloudTrail read. Example scope: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/{engagement_id}/* and cloudtrail:LookupEvents on our audit account.

leo: Tagging in to ask about KMS: we should not create grants that allow Decrypt without auditing. Plan: create grants with EncryptionContext requirements and force AWS CloudTrail to log kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey calls.

ops-bot: System note: CloudTrail -> SIEM forwarding configured to index "security_cloudtrail". KMS events are included. Default retention 90d hot, 365d cold. To extend retention request INF-LOG-RETENTION.

jack: Who packages evidence? We can provide bundles but prefer assessor pulls to reduce data movement. We'll create a timeboxed read-only bucket per engagement and a presigned URL for the bundle. Include manifest with sha256 and a README for verification steps.

eva: I'll prepare a short playbook with commands:

```bash
# create presigned bundle
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/${ENG_ID}/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
# revoke KMS grant
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id "$GRANT_ID"
# verify sha256
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
```

maria: Retest acceptance criteria proposal: 1) fix merged to main and deployed to canary 2) relevant logs show no reproduction within 48h 3) KMS logs show no suspicious Decrypt after fix 4) vendor confirms verified in writing. If assignee cannot validate, escalate to Sam.

sam: Also require a post-fix smoke test script from engineering which we can run during verification. Add it to the triage card.

jack: I'll spin up a retest board template and add checklist items: repro steps, fix PR, deployment link, log snippets, KMS events (CloudTrail IDs), sha256 manifest. Will add an "ops verification" checkbox for retention proof.

leo: One gotcha: if assessors need to run PRs or test accounts, use isolated test namespaces and ephemeral credentials; never point them at prod controllers. Document this in the playbook.

eva: Bundle contents minimal list: CloudTrail export (last 72h), kube-audit (namespaces in scope), application logs (48h), metrics snapshot, manifest with sha256s. Keep each file <10GB, split if bigger.

maria: Dry-run plan: Wed 10:00 UTC. We'll simulate a P1, create bundle, grant ephemeral access, then revoke and run the rollback playbook. Everyone OK to join?

sam: Ok for me. I'll bring SLA language drafts.

jack: I'll prepare the triage board and invite.

eva: I'll publish the playbook and sample commands to the ticket before Wed.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Wed 10:00 UTC. Automated checklist will post to channel at T-1h.

maria: Thanks all. I'll DM vendor to confirm window and share the dry-run agenda. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for playbook updates. :lock:
